mapper.insert: INSERT INTO businesses ( owner_id, name, slug, business_type, phone, address, description, profile_image_url, gallery_images, latitude, longitude, tags, average_rating, review_count, business_hours, status, subscription_plan, subscription_status, trial_started_at, trial_ends_at, current_staff_count, current_month_reservation_count ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{businessType}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{description}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{galleryImages, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{tags}, #{averageRating}, #{reviewCount}, #{businessHours, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{status}, #{subscriptionPlan}, #{subscriptionStatus}, #{trialStartedAt}, #{trialEndsAt}, #{currentStaffCount}, #{currentMonthReservationCount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE businesses SET name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, business_type = #{businessType}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, description = #{description}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, gallery_images = #{galleryImages, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, tags = #{tags}, average_rating = #{averageRating}, review_count = #{reviewCount}, business_hours = #{businessHours, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, status = #{status}, daily_revenue_goal = #{dailyRevenueGoal}, monthly_revenue_goal = #{monthlyRevenueGoal}, monthly_new_customer_goal = #{monthlyNewCustomerGoal}, subscription_plan = #{subscriptionPlan}, subscription_status = #{subscriptionStatus}, trial_started_at = #{trialStartedAt}, trial_ends_at = #{trialEndsAt}, subscription_started_at = #{subscriptionStartedAt}, next_billing_date = #{nextBillingDate}, current_staff_count = #{currentStaffCount}, current_month_reservation_count = #{currentMonthReservationCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE businesses SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM businesses WHERE id = #{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses
AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE business_type = #{type}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', #{date}::date)

SELECT b.id as businessId, b.name as businessName, u.name as ownerName, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_price), 0) as totalRevenue, COUNT(r.id) as reservationCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.total_price), 0) DESC) as rank FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON b.id = r.business_id AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY b.id, b.name, u.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM businesses WHERE slug = #{slug})
mapper.update: UPDATE businesses SET slug = #{slug}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE businesses SET profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE businesses SET average_rating = #{averageRating}, review_count = #{reviewCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM businesses WHERE subscription_status = 'TRIAL' AND trial_ends_at < #{now} ORDER BY trial_ends_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE businesses SET current_month_reservation_count = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE current_month_reservation_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM businesses WHERE subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_billing_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(next_billing_date) <= DATE(#{date}) ORDER BY next_billing_date ASC
SELECT * FROM businesses WHERE subscription_status = 'TRIAL' AND trial_ends_at BETWEEN #{targetDate} - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{rangeDays} AND #{targetDate} ORDER BY trial_ends_at ASC
SELECT * FROM businesses WHERE subscription_status = 'EXPIRED' AND updated_at >= #{since} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
